name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: A drag-and-drop area for a file input, with previews, removal and type, size and count limits. Files are submitted with the form.

classes.name: dropzone
classes.description: The drop area. Holds the clickable area and the file list.

classes.name: dropzone__area
classes.description: The clickable part. Make it a <label> around the file input so clicking opens the file picker.

classes.name: dropzone__files
classes.description: The list the previews are rendered into (a <ul>).

classes.name: dropzone__file
classes.description: A preview, rendered by the script. Gets data-error when the file was rejected.

classes.name: dropzone__thumbnail
classes.description: Image thumbnail, or the file extension for other files.

classes.name: dropzone__meta
classes.description: File size, or the reason the file was rejected.

attributes.name: data-dropzone-target="input"
attributes.description: The file input that holds the files. Its accept and multiple attributes are respected.

attributes.name: data-dropzone-max-file-size
attributes.description: Maximum size of one file, in megabytes (decimals allowed).

attributes.name: data-dropzone-type-message
attributes.description: Error shown for a file that does not match accept.

attributes.name: data-dropzone-size-message
attributes.description: Error shown for a file larger than the limit.

attributes.name: data-dropzone-count-message
attributes.description: Error shown for files over the count limit.

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Removes a file. Used by the remove buttons in the previews.

events.name: velle:dropzone:change
events.description: Dispatched when the files change. event.detail.files lists the accepted files, event.detail.rejected the rejected ones.

notes: The form must use method="post" and enctype="multipart/form-data" for the files to be sent.
Rejected files are shown with the reason and never added to the input. They are cleared on the next drop or pick.
Resetting the form clears the files.
This replaces css-zero's Dropzone.js + Rails ActiveStorage direct-upload integration; no library or upload endpoint is needed.

examples.title: Limits
examples.description: Up to 3 images of at most 300 KB each.
